# ANALYSIS: BASE_ENGINE_STAGE1_VALIDATION

**Filed:** 2026-07-23  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** validation  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Summary

Ran Stage-1 backtest on current engine (no candidate changes) to compute OP-16 edge_capture and concentration. Then performed OOS walk-forward validation and real-fills validation on top 3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04). Results show base engine edge_capture=780 (matches leaderboard STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND baseline), concentration analysis indicates moderate winner dependency, OOS walk-forward shows declining Sharpe in recent months, and real-fills validation reveals slippage impact on entry premium.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (per OP-20 disclosure 1)  
2. **Sample bias:** Stage-1 backtest uses 16 months (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18), selection method = all available SPY 5m bars; overfit risk mitigated by OP-16 anchor gates but concentration risk present (top5_pct >50%)  
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward results above are preliminary; full OOS requires out-of-sample period beyond 2026-06-18)  
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (slippage check on top 3 J days shows ~8% degradation; full validation requires per-trade fill analysis)  
5. **Failure modes:**  
   - Worst day: 5/06 loser day (-$300 if taken)  
   - Max drawdown: -$2,273 (per STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND)  
   - Blow-up scenario: consecutive loser days with position sizing at max risk (e.g., 5/05-5/06-5/07 sequence: -$665 loss)  
6. **Concentration:** top-5 days = 50.6% of P&L (per above calculation; if actual top5_pct >60%, engine relies on few days)
